var GlobalTangleCooldown = Shares the 12 second global <strand/>Tangle creation cooldown.

var Reload = Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.

var ElementalPickup = Elemental Pickups include <solar/>Firesprites, <arc/>Ionic Traces, <stasis/>Stasis Shards, <strand/>Tangles, and <void/>Void Breaches.

var ChunkEnergyScalars = Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in <link our explainer blog post on the Clarity website [https://url.d2clarity.com/chunk-energy-scalars] />.

var ChunkEnergyUnaffected = Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in <link our explainer blog post on the Clarity website [https://url.d2clarity.com/chunk-energy-scalars] />.

var MeleeAbilityDisambiguation = Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

var ExplosiveBuffExclusion = Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.
